name: speckle type BTB/POZ protein

function.text: SPOP encodes speckle-type POZ protein. Annotated molecular activities include molecular function inhibitor activity and ubiquitin protein ligase binding. It participates in protein polyubiquitination and regulation of proteolysis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to neurodevelopmental disorder with relative macrocephaly and with or without cardiac or endocrine anomalies (autosomal dominant); neurodevelopmental disorder with microcephaly and dysmorphic facies (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Prostate adenocarcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
